'''Honwoo's repair shop''' was a specialized [[Droid/Legends|droid]] repair shop on [[Anchorhead/Legends|Anchorhead]], [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], owned by [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Honwoo]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="Folio" />

The shop handled with Tatooine's limited supply of droids, and employed the [[Human/Legends|Human]] technician [[Mathus]].<ref name="Folio" />
